indicadores.subtitulo: Vendas autorizadas, evolução, clientes e distribuição geográfica
sqlBase: SELECT T007_Id AS id, T007_Numero_Nota_Fiscal AS documento, T007_Data_Emissao AS data,
COALESCE(D024_Nome_Empresa, T007_Cliente_Razao, 'Não informado') AS descricao, COALESCE(D018_UF, 'Não informado') AS uf, COALESCE(D020_Nome_Cidade, 'Não informado') AS cidade,

CASE WHEN D018_UF IN ('AC', 'AP', 'AM', 'PA', 'RO', 'RR', 'TO') THEN 'Norte' WHEN D018_UF IN ('AL', 'BA', 'CE', 'MA', 'PB', 'PE', 'PI', 'RN', 'SE') THEN 'Nordeste' WHEN D018_UF IN ('DF', 'GO', 'MT', 'MS') THEN 'Centro-Oeste' WHEN D018_UF IN ('ES', 'MG', 'RJ', 'SP') THEN 'Sudeste' WHEN D018_UF IN ('PR', 'RS', 'SC') THEN 'Sul' ELSE 'Não informado' END AS regiao,
CASE WHEN T007_Flag_ACP = '6' THEN 'NF-e' WHEN T007_Flag_ACP = '8' THEN 'NFC-e' ELSE 'Outro' END AS tipoDocumento,
GREATEST(IFNULL(T007_Valor_Total, 0) - IFNULL(T007_Valor_Total_IPI, 0) - IFNULL(T007_Valor_Frete, 0), 0) AS valor
FROM T007
INNER JOIN D006 ON D006_Id = T007_D006_Id
LEFT JOIN D024 ON D024_Id = T007_D024_Id
LEFT JOIN D018 ON D018_Id = D024_D018_Id
LEFT JOIN D020 ON D020_Id = D024_D020_Id
WHERE T007_C004_Id = :empresa
AND T007_Data_Emissao BETWEEN :dataInicio AND :dataFim
AND T007_Flag_Entrada_Saida = 'S'
AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Emitida_Recebida, '') <> 'R'
AND IFNULL(T007_Numero_Protocolo_Nfe, '') <> ''
AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Cancelada, 'N') <> 'S'
AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Inutilizado, 'N') <> 'S'
AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Denegado, 'N') <> 'S'
AND IFNULL(D006_Flag_Devolucao, 'N') <> 'S'
AND D006_Flag_Entrada_Saida = 'S'
AND D006_Flag_Venda_Compra_Outros = 'V'
AND (:cliente = '' OR COALESCE(D024_Nome_Empresa, T007_Cliente_Razao, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%'))
AND (:uf = '' OR D018_UF = :uf)

card.descricao: Total das vendas autorizadas, descontando IPI e frete.

sqlBase: SELECT T002_Id AS id, T002_Numero_Documento AS documento, T002_Nome_Cliente AS descricao,

CASE WHEN (T002_Data_Recebimento IS NULL OR T002_Data_Recebimento = '0000-00-00') AND T002_Data_Vencimento < CURRENT_DATE() AND DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), T002_Data_Vencimento) > 30 THEN 'Vencido acima de 30 dias' WHEN (T002_Data_Recebimento IS NULL OR T002_Data_Recebimento = '0000-00-00') AND T002_Data_Vencimento < CURRENT_DATE() THEN 'Vencido de 1 a 30 dias' WHEN (T002_Data_Recebimento IS NULL OR T002_Data_Recebimento = '0000-00-00') AND T002_Data_Vencimento = CURRENT_DATE() THEN 'Vence hoje' WHEN T002_Data_Recebimento IS NULL OR T002_Data_Recebimento = '0000-00-00' THEN 'A vencer' ELSE 'Recebido' END AS situacao,
CASE WHEN T002_Data_Recebimento IS NULL OR T002_Data_Recebimento = '0000-00-00' THEN T002_Data_Vencimento ELSE T002_Data_Recebimento END AS data,
T002_Data_Vencimento AS dataVencimento, NULLIF(T002_Data_Recebimento, '0000-00-00') AS dataBaixa,
GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CASE WHEN T002_Data_Recebimento IS NULL OR T002_Data_Recebimento = '0000-00-00' THEN CURRENT_DATE() ELSE T002_Data_Recebimento END, T002_Data_Vencimento), 0) AS diasAtraso,
CASE WHEN (T002_Data_Recebimento IS NULL OR T002_Data_Recebimento = '0000-00-00') AND T002_Data_Vencimento < CURRENT_DATE() THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END AS atrasado,
CASE WHEN T002_Data_Recebimento IS NULL OR T002_Data_Recebimento = '0000-00-00' THEN T002_Valor_Saldo ELSE T002_Valor_Recebido END AS valor,
CASE WHEN (T002_Data_Recebimento IS NULL OR T002_Data_Recebimento = '0000-00-00') AND T002_Data_Vencimento < CURRENT_DATE() THEN T002_Valor_Saldo ELSE 0 END AS valorVencido,
CASE WHEN (T002_Data_Recebimento IS NULL OR T002_Data_Recebimento = '0000-00-00') AND T002_Data_Vencimento >= CURRENT_DATE() THEN T002_Valor_Saldo ELSE 0 END AS valorAVencer,
CASE WHEN T002_Data_Recebimento IS NOT NULL AND T002_Data_Recebimento <> '0000-00-00' THEN T002_Valor_Recebido ELSE 0 END AS valorBaixado
FROM T002
WHERE ((:abrangenciaEmpresa = 'atual' AND T002_C004_Id = :empresa) OR (:abrangenciaEmpresa = 'todas' AND T002_C004_Id IN (1, 2, 4, 5)))
AND IFNULL(T002_Flag_Cancelada, 'N') <> 'S'
AND (:pessoa = '' OR T002_Nome_Cliente LIKE CONCAT('%', :pessoa, '%'))

AND (:status = '' OR (:status = 'aberto' AND (T002_Data_Recebimento IS NULL OR T002_Data_Recebimento = '0000-00-00')) OR (:status = 'vencido' AND (T002_Data_Recebimento IS NULL OR T002_Data_Recebimento = '0000-00-00') AND T002_Data_Vencimento < CURRENT_DATE()) OR (:status = 'vencer' AND (T002_Data_Recebimento IS NULL OR T002_Data_Recebimento = '0000-00-00') AND T002_Data_Vencimento >= CURRENT_DATE()) OR (:status = 'baixado' AND T002_Data_Recebimento IS NOT NULL AND T002_Data_Recebimento <> '0000-00-00'))

AND (((T002_Data_Recebimento IS NULL OR T002_Data_Recebimento = '0000-00-00') AND (T002_T002_Id_Agrupado IS NULL OR T002_T002_Id_Agrupado <= 0) AND IFNULL(T002_Valor_Saldo, 0) > 0 AND IFNULL(T002_Valor_Saldo, 0) >= :valorMinimo AND T002_Data_Vencimento BETWEEN :dataInicio AND :dataFim) OR (T002_Data_Recebimento IS NOT NULL AND T002_Data_Recebimento <> '0000-00-00' AND IFNULL(T002_Valor_Recebido, 0) > 0 AND IFNULL(T002_Valor_Recebido, 0) >= :valorMinimo AND T002_Data_Recebimento BETWEEN :dataInicio AND :dataFim))

sqlBase: SELECT calculado.id, calculado.produtoId, calculado.codigo, calculado.descricao, calculado.imagem, calculado.quantidade, calculado.valor, calculado.precoMedio, calculado.posicao, calculado.percentualAcumulado,
CASE WHEN calculado.percentualAcumulado <= 80 THEN 'A' WHEN calculado.percentualAcumulado <= 95 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS classificacao
FROM (
SELECT produtos.id, produtos.produtoId, produtos.codigo, produtos.descricao, produtos.imagem, produtos.quantidade, produtos.valor, produtos.precoMedio,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY produtos.valor DESC, produtos.codigo) AS posicao,

CASE WHEN SUM(produtos.valor) OVER () > 0 THEN (SUM(produtos.valor) OVER (ORDER BY produtos.valor DESC, produtos.codigo ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) / SUM(produtos.valor) OVER ()) * 100 ELSE 0 END AS percentualAcumulado
FROM (
SELECT MIN(T008_Id) AS id, COALESCE(D001_Id, T008_D009_Id, T008_Id) AS produtoId, COALESCE(NULLIF(D001_Codigo_Produto, ''), T008_Codigo_Produto, 'Sem código') AS codigo,
COALESCE(NULLIF(D001_Descricao_Produto, ''), T008_Descricao_Produto, T008_Codigo_Produto, 'Não informado') AS descricao,
CONCAT('product-image.php?produto=', COALESCE(D001_Id, 0), '&foto=', COALESCE(fotos.fotoId, 0)) AS imagem,
COALESCE(SUM(T008_Quantidade), 0) AS quantidade, COALESCE(SUM(T008_Valor_Total_Preco), 0) AS valor,
CASE WHEN SUM(T008_Quantidade) > 0 THEN SUM(T008_Valor_Total_Preco) / SUM(T008_Quantidade) ELSE 0 END AS precoMedio
FROM T008
INNER JOIN T007 ON T007_Id = T008_T007_Id AND T007_C004_Id = :empresa
INNER JOIN D006 ON D006_Id = T007_D006_Id
LEFT JOIN D009 ON D009_Id = T008_D009_Id

LEFT JOIN D001 ON D001_Id = D049_D001_Id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT T172_D001_Id AS produtoFotoId, MAX(T172_Id) AS fotoId FROM T172 GROUP BY T172_D001_Id) AS fotos ON fotos.produtoFotoId = D001_Id
WHERE T008_C004_Id = :empresa
AND T007_Data_Emissao BETWEEN :dataInicio AND :dataFim
AND T007_Flag_Entrada_Saida = 'S'
AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Emitida_Recebida, '') <> 'R'
AND IFNULL(T007_Numero_Protocolo_Nfe, '') <> ''
AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Cancelada, 'N') <> 'S'
AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Inutilizado, 'N') <> 'S'

AND (:produto = '' OR T008_Codigo_Produto LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%') OR COALESCE(D001_Descricao_Produto, T008_Descricao_Produto, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%'))

GROUP BY COALESCE(D001_Id, T008_D009_Id, T008_Id), D001_Id, COALESCE(NULLIF(D001_Codigo_Produto, ''), T008_Codigo_Produto, 'Sem código'), COALESCE(NULLIF(D001_Descricao_Produto, ''), T008_Descricao_Produto, T008_Codigo_Produto, 'Não informado'), fotos.fotoId
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(T008_Valor_Total_Preco), 0) >= :valorMinimo

) AS calculado

es.C007_Id))) OR ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C007 es WHERE es.C007_Id = ev.C007_C007_Id AND UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(es.C007_Nome, ''), es.C007_Primeiro_Nome, ''))) = 'ALESSANDRO' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C007 vinc WHERE vinc.C007_C007_Id = es.C007_Id))) AND NOT ((ec.C004_Id = 1 AND (ev.C007_Id IN (83, 79))) OR (ec.C004_Id = 1 AND (ev.C007_Id IN (89))) OR (ec.C004_Id = 1 AND (ev.C007_Id IN (77))) OR (TRIM(ec.C004_Cnpj) IN ('17750961000540', '17.750.961/0005-40') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM C007 es WHERE es.C007_Id = ev.C007_Id AND UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(es.C007_Nome, ''), sqlBase: SELECT T008_Id AS id, T007_Numero_Nota_Fiscal AS documento, T007_Data_Emissao AS data,
COALESCE(D001_Id, T008_D009_Id, T008_Id) AS produtoId, COALESCE(NULLIF(D001_Codigo_Produto, ''), T008_Codigo_Produto, 'Sem código') AS codigo,
COALESCE(NULLIF(D001_Descricao_Produto, ''), T008_Descricao_Produto, T008_Codigo_Produto, 'Não informado') AS produto,
COALESCE(D082_Id, 0) AS marcaId, COALESCE(NULLIF(D082_Marca, ''), 'Sem marca') AS marca,
CONCAT('product-image.php?produto=', COALESCE(D001_Id, 0), '&foto=', COALESCE(fotos.fotoId, 0)) AS imagem,
COALESCE(T008_Quantidade, 0) AS quantidadeVendida, COALESCE(T008_Valor_Total_Preco, 0) AS valor, COALESCE(D009_Quantidade_Estoque_Liquido, 0) AS saldoEstoque,

CASE WHEN COALESCE(D009_Quantidade_Estoque_Liquido, 0) <= 0 THEN 'Sem estoque' WHEN COALESCE(D009_Quantidade_Estoque_Liquido, 0) <= 10 THEN 'Estoque baixo' ELSE 'Estoque normal' END AS situacaoEstoque,
COALESCE(D024_Nome_Empresa, T007_Cliente_Razao, 'Não informado') AS cliente, COALESCE(D018_UF, 'Não informado') AS uf, COALESCE(D020_Nome_Cidade, 'Não informado') AS cidade
FROM T008
INNER JOIN T007 ON T007_Id = T008_T007_Id AND T007_C004_Id = :empresa
INNER JOIN D006 ON D006_Id = T007_D006_Id
LEFT JOIN D009 ON D009_Id = T008_D009_Id
LEFT JOIN D049 ON D049_Id = D009_D049_Id
LEFT JOIN D001 ON D001_Id = D049_D001_Id
LEFT JOIN D082 ON D082_Id = D049_D082_Id
LEFT JOIN D024 ON D024_Id = T007_D024_Id
LEFT JOIN D018 ON D018_Id = D024_D018_Id
LEFT JOIN D020 ON D020_Id = D024_D020_Id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT T172_D001_Id AS produtoFotoId, MAX(T172_Id) AS fotoId FROM T172 GROUP BY T172_D001_Id) AS fotos ON fotos.produtoFotoId = D001_Id
WHERE T008_C004_Id = :empresa
AND T007_Data_Emissao BETWEEN :dataInicio AND :dataFim
AND T007_Flag_Entrada_Saida = 'S'
AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Emitida_Recebida, '') <> 'R'
AND IFNULL(T007_Numero_Protocolo_Nfe, '') <> ''
AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Cancelada, 'N') <> 'S'
AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Inutilizado, 'N') <> 'S'
AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Denegado, 'N') <> 'S'
AND IFNULL(D006_Flag_Devolucao, 'N') <> 'S'
AND D006_Flag_Venda_Compra_Outros = 'V'
AND IFNULL(T008_Flag_Excluir, 'N') <> 'S'
AND (:marca = '' OR D082_Id = :marca)
AND (:produto = '' OR T008_Codigo_Produto LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%') OR COALESCE(D001_Descricao_Produto, T008_Descricao_Produto, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%'))

AND (:estoque = '' OR (:estoque = 'sem' AND COALESCE(D009_Quantidade_Estoque_Liquido, 0) <= 0) OR (:estoque = 'baixo' AND COALESCE(D009_Quantidade_Estoque_Liquido, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(D009_Quantidade_Estoque_Liquido, 0) <= 10) OR (:estoque = 'normal' AND COALESCE(D009_Quantidade_Estoque_Liquido, 0) > 10))
AND (:uf = '' OR D018_UF = :uf)

SELECT op.T255_Id AS id,
CAST(op.T255_Id AS CHAR) AS op,
p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS data,
p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS dataInicio,
p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS dataFim,
op.T255_Data_Emissao AS emissao,
COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) AS valor,
CASE CAST(p.T255A_Flag_Maquina AS CHAR) WHEN '0' THEN 'Blank' WHEN '1' THEN 'Slitter' WHEN '2' THEN 'Combinado' ELSE 'Não informada' END AS maquina,
p.T255A_Sequencial AS sequencial,
CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status = '98' OR COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') NOT IN ('', '0')) THEN 'Cancelada' WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status = '99' THEN 'Finalizada' ELSE 'Aberta' END AS situacao,
COALESCE(p.T255A_Observacao, '') AS dimensoes,
COALESCE(op.T255_Observacao, '') AS observacao,
CASE WHEN p.T255A_Liberado_Producao = 'S' THEN 'Sim' ELSE 'Não' END AS liberada,
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CAST(pedido.T005_Id AS CHAR) ORDER BY CAST(pedido.T005_Id AS CHAR) SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id LEFT JOIN D060 AS setor ON setor.D060_Id = prod.D001_D060_Id LEFT JOIN D015 AS acabamento ON acabamento.D015_Id = prod.D001_D015_Id LEFT JOIN SMT029 AS material ON material.SMT029_Id = ext.D001A_SMT029_Id LEFT JOIN T006 AS vendaItem ON vendaItem.T006_Id = item.T256_T006_Id LEFT JOIN T005 AS pedido ON pedido.T005_Id = vendaItem.T006_T005_Id AND pedido.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id LEFT JOIN D024 AS cliente ON cliente.D024_Id = pedido.T005_D024_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id) AS pedidos,
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(cliente.D024_Nome_Empresa, 'Estoque / sem pedido') ORDER BY COALESCE(cliente.D024_Nome_Empresa, 'Estoque / sem pedido') SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id LEFT JOIN D060 AS setor ON setor.D060_Id = prod.D001_D060_Id LEFT JOIN D015 AS acabamento ON acabamento.D015_Id = prod.D001_D015_Id LEFT JOIN SMT029 AS material ON material.SMT029_Id = ext.D001A_SMT029_Id LEFT JOIN T006 AS vendaItem ON vendaItem.T006_Id = item.T256_T006_Id LEFT JOIN T005 AS pedido ON pedido.T005_Id = vendaItem.T006_T005_Id AND pedido.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id LEFT JOIN D024 AS cliente ON cliente.D024_Id = pedido.T005_D024_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id) AS clientes,
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT prod.D001_Descricao_Produto ORDER BY prod.D001_Descricao_Produto SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id LEFT JOIN D060 AS setor ON setor.D060_Id = prod.D001_D060_Id LEFT JOIN D015 AS acabamento ON acabamento.D015_Id = prod.D001_D015_Id LEFT JOIN SMT029 AS material ON material.SMT029_Id = ext.D001A_SMT029_Id LEFT JOIN T006 AS vendaItem ON vendaItem.T006_Id = item.T256_T006_Id LEFT JOIN T005 AS pedido ON pedido.T005_Id = vendaItem.T006_T005_Id AND pedido.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id LEFT JOIN D024 AS cliente ON cliente.D024_Id = pedido.T005_D024_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id) AS produtos,
CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao, '%Y-%m'), ' / Semana ', FLOOR((DAYOFMONTH(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) - 1 + WEEKDAY(DATE_SUB(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao, INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) - 1 DAY))) / 7) + 1) AS semanaMes,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 0 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS segunda,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 1 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS terca,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 2 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS quarta,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 3 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS quinta,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 4 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS sexta,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 5 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS sabado,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 6 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS domingo,
(SELECT MIN(ent.T256_Data_Previsao_Entrega) FROM T256 AS ent WHERE ent.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id AND ent.T256_Data_Previsao_Entrega IS NOT NULL AND CAST(ent.T256_Data_Previsao_Entrega AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00') AND COALESCE(ent.T256_Quantidade, 0) > COALESCE(ent.T256_Quantidade_Produzida, 0)) AS entregaProxima,
CASE WHEN NOT (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) THEN 'Encerrada' WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE() THEN 'Fim previsto vencido' WHEN NOT (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) THEN 'Sem início previsto' WHEN NOT (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) THEN 'Sem fim previsto' WHEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Liberado_Producao, 'N') <> 'S' THEN 'Sem liberação' WHEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) <= 0 THEN 'Sem peso previsto' ELSE 'Programada e liberada' END AS prioridade,
CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND ((op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE()) THEN 1 WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (NOT (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00'))) THEN 2 WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (NOT (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00'))) THEN 3 WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (COALESCE(p.T255A_Liberado_Producao, 'N') <> 'S') THEN 4 WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) <= 0) THEN 5 ELSE 6 END AS ordemPrioridade,
CONCAT(CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND ((op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE()) THEN 'Fim previsto vencido | ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (NOT (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00'))) THEN 'Sem início previsto | ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (NOT (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00'))) THEN 'Sem fim previsto | ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (COALESCE(p.T255A_Liberado_Producao, 'N') <> 'S') THEN 'Sem liberação | ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) <= 0) THEN 'Sem peso previsto | ' ELSE '' END) AS pendencias,
CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE() THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao) ELSE 0 END AS diasAtraso,
CASE WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pesoAberto,
CASE WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status = '99' AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pesoFinalizado,
CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE() THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pesoAtrasado,
CASE WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS opsAbertas,
CASE WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status = '99' AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS opsFinalizadas,
CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS opsAtrasadas,
CASE WHEN (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao >= :dataInicio AND p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao <= :dataFim) THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pesoPeriodo,
CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') AND op.T255_Data_Emissao <= :dataFim) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS qtdFila,
CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') AND op.T255_Data_Emissao <= :dataFim) AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Liberado_Producao, 'N') <> 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS qtdSemLiberacao,
CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') AND op.T255_Data_Emissao <= :dataFim) AND (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao IS NULL OR CAST(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS CHAR) IN ('', '0000-00-00') OR p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NULL OR CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) IN ('', '0000-00-00')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS qtdSemDatas,
CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') AND op.T255_Data_Emissao <= :dataFim) AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS qtdSemPeso
FROM T255 AS op
LEFT JOIN T255A AS p ON p.T255A_Id = (SELECT MAX(px.T255A_Id) FROM T255A AS px WHERE px.T255A_T255_Id = op.T255_Id)
WHERE ((:abrangenciaEmpresa = 'atual' AND op.T255_C004_Id = :empresa) OR ((:abrangenciaEmpresa = 'todas' OR :abrangenciaEmpresa = CAST(op.T255_C004_Id AS CHAR)) AND op.T255_C004_Id IN (1, 2, 4, 5)))
AND (:maquina = '' OR CAST(p.T255A_Flag_Maquina AS CHAR) = :maquina)

AND ((:status = '' AND NOT ((op.T255_Flag_Status = '98' OR COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') NOT IN ('', '0')))) OR :status = CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status = '98' OR COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') NOT IN ('', '0')) THEN 'Cancelada' WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status = '99' THEN 'Finalizada' ELSE 'Aberta' END)

AND (:op = 0 OR op.T255_Id = :op) AND (:planoCorte = '' OR (:planoCorte = 'S' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT134 AS corte WHERE corte.SMT134_T255_Id = op.T255_Id)) OR (:planoCorte = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT134 AS corte WHERE corte.SMT134_T255_Id = op.T255_Id)))

AND ((:setor = '' AND :acabamento = '' AND :material = '' AND :produto = '') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id AND (:setor = '' OR prod.D001_D060_Id = :setor) AND (:acabamento = '' OR prod.D001_D015_Id = :acabamento) AND (:material = '' OR ext.D001A_SMT029_Id = :material) AND (:produto = '' OR prod.D001_Codigo_Produto LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%') OR prod.D001_Descricao_Produto LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%'))))

AND (:cliente = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T256 AS ci INNER JOIN T006 AS vi ON vi.T006_Id = ci.T256_T006_Id INNER JOIN T005 AS pv ON pv.T005_Id = vi.T006_T005_Id AND pv.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id INNER JOIN D024 AS cl ON cl.D024_Id = pv.T005_D024_Id WHERE ci.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id AND cl.D024_Nome_Empresa LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%')))

AND ((p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao >= :dataInicio AND p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao <= :dataFim) OR (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') AND op.T255_Data_Emissao <= :dataFim))

CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status = '98' OR COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') NOT IN ('', '0')) THEN 'Cancelada' WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status = '99' THEN 'Finalizada' ELSE 'Aberta' END AS situacao,

CASE WHEN p.T255A_Liberado_Producao = 'S' THEN 'Sim' ELSE 'Não' END AS liberada,
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CAST(pedido.T005_Id AS CHAR) ORDER BY CAST(pedido.T005_Id AS CHAR) SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id LEFT JOIN D060 AS setor ON setor.D060_Id = prod.D001_D060_Id LEFT JOIN D015 AS acabamento ON acabamento.D015_Id = prod.D001_D015_Id LEFT JOIN SMT029 AS material ON material.SMT029_Id = ext.D001A_SMT029_Id LEFT JOIN T006 AS vendaItem ON vendaItem.T006_Id = item.T256_T006_Id LEFT JOIN T005 AS pedido ON pedido.T005_Id = vendaItem.T006_T005_Id AND pedido.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id LEFT JOIN D024 AS cliente ON cliente.D024_Id = pedido.T005_D024_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id) AS pedidos,
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(cliente.D024_Nome_Empresa, 'Estoque / sem pedido') ORDER BY COALESCE(cliente.D024_Nome_Empresa, 'Estoque / sem pedido') SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id LEFT JOIN D060 AS setor ON setor.D060_Id = prod.D001_D060_Id LEFT JOIN D015 AS acabamento ON acabamento.D015_Id = prod.D001_D015_Id LEFT JOIN SMT029 AS material ON material.SMT029_Id = ext.D001A_SMT029_Id LEFT JOIN T006 AS vendaItem ON vendaItem.T006_Id = item.T256_T006_Id LEFT JOIN T005 AS pedido ON pedido.T005_Id = vendaItem.T006_T005_Id AND pedido.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id LEFT JOIN D024 AS cliente ON cliente.D024_Id = pedido.T005_D024_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id) AS clientes,
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT prod.D001_Descricao_Produto ORDER BY prod.D001_Descricao_Produto SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id LEFT JOIN D060 AS setor ON setor.D060_Id = prod.D001_D060_Id LEFT JOIN D015 AS acabamento ON acabamento.D015_Id = prod.D001_D015_Id LEFT JOIN SMT029 AS material ON material.SMT029_Id = ext.D001A_SMT029_Id LEFT JOIN T006 AS vendaItem ON vendaItem.T006_Id = item.T256_T006_Id LEFT JOIN T005 AS pedido ON pedido.T005_Id = vendaItem.T006_T005_Id AND pedido.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id LEFT JOIN D024 AS cliente ON cliente.D024_Id = pedido.T005_D024_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id) AS produtos,
CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao, '%Y-%m'), ' / Semana ', FLOOR((DAYOFMONTH(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) - 1 + WEEKDAY(DATE_SUB(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao, INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) - 1 DAY))) / 7) + 1) AS semanaMes,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 0 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS segunda,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 1 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS terca,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 2 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS quarta,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 3 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS quinta,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 4 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS sexta,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 5 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS sabado,

(SELECT MIN(ent.T256_Data_Previsao_Entrega) FROM T256 AS ent WHERE ent.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id AND ent.T256_Data_Previsao_Entrega IS NOT NULL AND CAST(ent.T256_Data_Previsao_Entrega AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00') AND COALESCE(ent.T256_Quantidade, 0) > COALESCE(ent.T256_Quantidade_Produzida, 0)) AS entregaProxima,
CASE WHEN NOT (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) THEN 'Encerrada' WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE() THEN 'Fim previsto vencido' WHEN NOT (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) THEN 'Sem início previsto' WHEN NOT (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) THEN 'Sem fim previsto' WHEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Liberado_Producao, 'N') <> 'S' THEN 'Sem liberação' WHEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) <= 0 THEN 'Sem peso previsto' ELSE 'Programada e liberada' END AS prioridade,

CASE WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status = '99' AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS opsFinalizadas,

prod.D001_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id AND (:setor = '' OR prod.D001_D060_Id = :setor) AND (:acabamento = '' OR prod.D001_D015_Id = :acabamento) AND (:material = '' OR ext.D001A_SMT029_Id = :material) AND (:produto = '' OR prod.D001_Codigo_Produto LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%') OR prod.D001_Descricao_Produto LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%')))) AND (:cliente = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T256 AS ci INNER JOIN T006 AS vi ON vi.T006_Id = ci.T256_T006_Id INNER JOIN T005 AS pv ON pv.T005_Id = vi.T006_T005_Id AND pv.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id INNER JOIN D024 AS cl ON cl.D024_Id = pv.T005_D024_Id WHERE ci.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id AND cl.D024_Nome_Empresa LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%'))) AND p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao >= :dataInicio AND p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao <= :dataFim) AS planejamento GROUP BY `semanaMes` ORDER BY `semanaMes`

secoes.subtitulo: Peso previsto de OPs do período. Fim vencido é parte das OPs abertas.
sqlBase:
SELECT `maquina`, SUM(`valor`) AS valor, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS quantidade, SUM(`pesoAberto`) AS `pesoAberto`, SUM(`pesoFinalizado`) AS `pesoFinalizado`, SUM(`pesoAtrasado`) AS `pesoAtrasado`, SUM(`opsAbertas`) AS `opsAbertas`, SUM(`opsFinalizadas`) AS `opsFinalizadas`, SUM(`opsAtrasadas`) AS `opsAtrasadas` FROM (SELECT op.T255_Id AS id,
CAST(op.T255_Id AS CHAR) AS op,
p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS data,
p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS dataInicio,
p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS dataFim,
op.T255_Data_Emissao AS emissao,
COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) AS valor,
CASE CAST(p.T255A_Flag_Maquina AS CHAR) WHEN '0' THEN 'Blank' WHEN '1' THEN 'Slitter' WHEN '2' THEN 'Combinado' ELSE 'Não informada' END AS maquina,
p.T255A_Sequencial AS sequencial,
CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status = '98' OR COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') NOT IN ('', '0')) THEN 'Cancelada' WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status = '99' THEN 'Finalizada' ELSE 'Aberta' END AS situacao,
COALESCE(p.T255A_Observacao, '') AS dimensoes,
COALESCE(op.T255_Observacao, '') AS observacao,
CASE WHEN p.T255A_Liberado_Producao = 'S' THEN 'Sim' ELSE 'Não' END AS liberada,
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CAST(pedido.T005_Id AS CHAR) ORDER BY CAST(pedido.T005_Id AS CHAR) SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id LEFT JOIN D060 AS setor ON setor.D060_Id = prod.D001_D060_Id LEFT JOIN D015 AS acabamento ON acabamento.D015_Id = prod.D001_D015_Id LEFT JOIN SMT029 AS material ON material.SMT029_Id = ext.D001A_SMT029_Id LEFT JOIN T006 AS vendaItem ON vendaItem.T006_Id = item.T256_T006_Id LEFT JOIN T005 AS pedido ON pedido.T005_Id = vendaItem.T006_T005_Id AND pedido.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id LEFT JOIN D024 AS cliente ON cliente.D024_Id = pedido.T005_D024_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id) AS pedidos,
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(cliente.D024_Nome_Empresa, 'Estoque / sem pedido') ORDER BY COALESCE(cliente.D024_Nome_Empresa, 'Estoque / sem pedido') SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id LEFT JOIN D060 AS setor ON setor.D060_Id = prod.D001_D060_Id LEFT JOIN D015 AS acabamento ON acabamento.D015_Id = prod.D001_D015_Id LEFT JOIN SMT029 AS material ON material.SMT029_Id = ext.D001A_SMT029_Id LEFT JOIN T006 AS vendaItem ON vendaItem.T006_Id = item.T256_T006_Id LEFT JOIN T005 AS pedido ON pedido.T005_Id = vendaItem.T006_T005_Id AND pedido.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id LEFT JOIN D024 AS cliente ON cliente.D024_Id = pedido.T005_D024_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id) AS clientes,
(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT prod.D001_Descricao_Produto ORDER BY prod.D001_Descricao_Produto SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id LEFT JOIN D060 AS setor ON setor.D060_Id = prod.D001_D060_Id LEFT JOIN D015 AS acabamento ON acabamento.D015_Id = prod.D001_D015_Id LEFT JOIN SMT029 AS material ON material.SMT029_Id = ext.D001A_SMT029_Id LEFT JOIN T006 AS vendaItem ON vendaItem.T006_Id = item.T256_T006_Id LEFT JOIN T005 AS pedido ON pedido.T005_Id = vendaItem.T006_T005_Id AND pedido.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id LEFT JOIN D024 AS cliente ON cliente.D024_Id = pedido.T005_D024_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id) AS produtos,
CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao, '%Y-%m'), ' / Semana ', FLOOR((DAYOFMONTH(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) - 1 + WEEKDAY(DATE_SUB(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao, INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) - 1 DAY))) / 7) + 1) AS semanaMes,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 0 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS segunda,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 1 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS terca,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 2 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS quarta,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 3 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS quinta,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 4 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS sexta,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 5 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS sabado,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 6 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS domingo,
(SELECT MIN(ent.T256_Data_Previsao_Entrega) FROM T256 AS ent WHERE ent.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id AND ent.T256_Data_Previsao_Entrega IS NOT NULL AND CAST(ent.T256_Data_Previsao_Entrega AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00') AND COALESCE(ent.T256_Quantidade, 0) > COALESCE(ent.T256_Quantidade_Produzida, 0)) AS entregaProxima,
CASE WHEN NOT (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) THEN 'Encerrada' WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE() THEN 'Fim previsto vencido' WHEN NOT (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) THEN 'Sem início previsto' WHEN NOT (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) THEN 'Sem fim previsto' WHEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Liberado_Producao, 'N') <> 'S' THEN 'Sem liberação' WHEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) <= 0 THEN 'Sem peso previsto' ELSE 'Programada e liberada' END AS prioridade,
CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND ((op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE()) THEN 1 WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (NOT (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00'))) THEN 2 WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (NOT (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00'))) THEN 3 WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (COALESCE(p.T255A_Liberado_Producao, 'N') <> 'S') THEN 4 WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) <= 0) THEN 5 ELSE 6 END AS ordemPrioridade,
CONCAT(CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND ((op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE()) THEN 'Fim previsto vencido | ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (NOT (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00'))) THEN 'Sem início previsto | ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (NOT (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00'))) THEN 'Sem fim previsto | ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (COALESCE(p.T255A_Liberado_Producao, 'N') <> 'S') THEN 'Sem liberação | ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) <= 0) THEN 'Sem peso previsto | ' ELSE '' END) AS pendencias,
CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE() THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao) ELSE 0 END AS diasAtraso,
CASE WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pesoAberto,
CASE WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status = '99' AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pesoFinalizado,
CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE() THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pesoAtrasado,
CASE WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS opsAbertas,
CASE WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status = '99' AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS opsFinalizadas,
CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS opsAtrasadas FROM T255 AS op LEFT JOIN T255A AS p ON p.T255A_Id = (SELECT MAX(px.T255A_Id) FROM T255A AS px WHERE px.T255A_T255_Id = op.T255_Id) WHERE ((:abrangenciaEmpresa = 'atual' AND op.T255_C004_Id = :empresa) OR ((:abrangenciaEmpresa = 'todas' OR :abrangenciaEmpresa = CAST(op.T255_C004_Id AS CHAR)) AND op.T255_C004_Id IN (1, 2, 4, 5))) AND (:maquina = '' OR CAST(p.T255A_Flag_Maquina AS CHAR) = :maquina) AND ((:status = '' AND NOT ((op.T255_Flag_Status = '98' OR COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') NOT IN ('', '0')))) OR :status = CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status = '98' OR COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') NOT IN ('', '0')) THEN 'Cancelada' WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status = '99' THEN 'Finalizada' ELSE 'Aberta' END) AND (:op = 0 OR op.T255_Id = :op) AND (:planoCorte = '' OR (:planoCorte = 'S' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT134 AS corte WHERE corte.SMT134_T255_Id = op.T255_Id)) OR (:planoCorte = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT134 AS corte WHERE corte.SMT134_T255_Id = op.T255_Id))) AND ((:setor = '' AND :acabamento = '' AND :material = '' AND :produto = '') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id AND (:setor = '' OR prod.D001_D060_Id = :setor) AND (:acabamento = '' OR prod.D001_D015_Id = :acabamento) AND (:material = '' OR ext.D001A_SMT029_Id = :material) AND (:produto = '' OR prod.D001_Codigo_Produto LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%') OR prod.D001_Descricao_Produto LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%')))) AND (:cliente = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T256 AS ci INNER JOIN T006 AS vi ON vi.T006_Id = ci.T256_T006_Id INNER JOIN T005 AS pv ON pv.T005_Id = vi.T006_T005_Id AND pv.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id INNER JOIN D024 AS cl ON cl.D024_Id = pv.T005_D024_Id WHERE ci.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id AND cl.D024_Nome_Empresa LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%'))) AND p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao >= :dataInicio AND p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao <= :dataFim) AS planejamento GROUP BY `maquina` ORDER BY `maquina`

secoes.subtitulo: Data do apontamento T257 e peso T257A. Inclui produção de OPs programadas fora do período. Máquina e filtros conforme cadastro atual da OP. Apontamentos sem peso positivo são sinalizados.
sqlBase: SELECT data,
SUM(CASE WHEN maquina = 'Blank' THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS blank,
SUM(CASE WHEN maquina = 'Slitter' THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS slitter,
SUM(CASE WHEN maquina = 'Combinado' THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS combinado,
SUM(CASE WHEN maquina = 'Não informada' THEN valor ELSE 0 END) AS semMaquina,
SUM(valor) AS valor,
COUNT(DISTINCT op) AS ops,
COUNT(*) AS apontamentos,
SUM(CASE WHEN valor <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS semPeso
FROM (SELECT realizado.T257_Id AS id,
op.T255_Id AS op,
realizado.T257_Data_Producao AS data,
COALESCE((SELECT SUM(peso.T257A_Peso) FROM T257A AS peso WHERE peso.T257A_T257_Id = realizado.T257_Id), 0) AS valor,
CASE CAST(p.T255A_Flag_Maquina AS CHAR) WHEN '0' THEN 'Blank' WHEN '1' THEN 'Slitter' WHEN '2' THEN 'Combinado' ELSE 'Não informada' END AS maquina
FROM T257 AS realizado
INNER JOIN T256 AS produzido ON produzido.T256_Id = realizado.T257_T256_Id
INNER JOIN T255 AS op ON op.T255_Id = produzido.T256_T255_Id
LEFT JOIN T255A AS p ON p.T255A_Id = (SELECT MAX(px.T255A_Id) FROM T255A AS px WHERE px.T255A_T255_Id = op.T255_Id)
WHERE ((:abrangenciaEmpresa = 'atual' AND op.T255_C004_Id = :empresa) OR ((:abrangenciaEmpresa = 'todas' OR :abrangenciaEmpresa = CAST(op.T255_C004_Id AS CHAR)) AND op.T255_C004_Id IN (1, 2, 4, 5)))
AND (:maquina = '' OR CAST(p.T255A_Flag_Maquina AS CHAR) = :maquina)

AND ((:status = '' AND NOT ((op.T255_Flag_Status = '98' OR COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') NOT IN ('', '0')))) OR :status = CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status = '98' OR COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') NOT IN ('', '0')) THEN 'Cancelada' WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status = '99' THEN 'Finalizada' ELSE 'Aberta' END)

AND (:op = 0 OR op.T255_Id = :op) AND (:planoCorte = '' OR (:planoCorte = 'S' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT134 AS corte WHERE corte.SMT134_T255_Id = op.T255_Id)) OR (:planoCorte = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT134 AS corte WHERE corte.SMT134_T255_Id = op.T255_Id)))

AND ((:setor = '' AND :acabamento = '' AND :material = '' AND :produto = '') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id AND (:setor = '' OR prod.D001_D060_Id = :setor) AND (:acabamento = '' OR prod.D001_D015_Id = :acabamento) AND (:material = '' OR ext.D001A_SMT029_Id = :material) AND (:produto = '' OR prod.D001_Codigo_Produto LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%') OR prod.D001_Descricao_Produto LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%'))))

AND (:cliente = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T257A AS pesoCliente INNER JOIN T005 AS pv ON pv.T005_Id = pesoCliente.T257A_T005_Id AND pv.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id INNER JOIN D024 AS cl ON cl.D024_Id = pv.T005_D024_Id WHERE pesoCliente.T257A_T257_Id = realizado.T257_Id AND cl.D024_Nome_Empresa LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%')))
AND realizado.T257_Data_Producao >= :dataInicio
AND realizado.T257_Data_Producao <= :dataFim) AS realizado_diario GROUP BY data ORDER BY data

secoes.subtitulo: Peso apontado nas datas selecionadas, agrupado pela máquina atual da OP. Uma OP pode produzir em mais de um dia.
sqlBase: SELECT maquina, SUM(valor) AS valor, COUNT(DISTINCT op) AS ops,
COUNT(*) AS apontamentos, SUM(CASE WHEN valor <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS semPeso
FROM (SELECT realizado.T257_Id AS id,
op.T255_Id AS op,
realizado.T257_Data_Producao AS data,
COALESCE((SELECT SUM(peso.T257A_Peso) FROM T257A AS peso WHERE peso.T257A_T257_Id = realizado.T257_Id), 0) AS valor,
CASE CAST(p.T255A_Flag_Maquina AS CHAR) WHEN '0' THEN 'Blank' WHEN '1' THEN 'Slitter' WHEN '2' THEN 'Combinado' ELSE 'Não informada' END AS maquina
FROM T257 AS realizado
INNER JOIN T256 AS produzido ON produzido.T256_Id = realizado.T257_T256_Id
INNER JOIN T255 AS op ON op.T255_Id = produzido.T256_T255_Id
LEFT JOIN T255A AS p ON p.T255A_Id = (SELECT MAX(px.T255A_Id) FROM T255A AS px WHERE px.T255A_T255_Id = op.T255_Id)
WHERE ((:abrangenciaEmpresa = 'atual' AND op.T255_C004_Id = :empresa) OR ((:abrangenciaEmpresa = 'todas' OR :abrangenciaEmpresa = CAST(op.T255_C004_Id AS CHAR)) AND op.T255_C004_Id IN (1, 2, 4, 5)))
AND (:maquina = '' OR CAST(p.T255A_Flag_Maquina AS CHAR) = :maquina)

AND ((:status = '' AND NOT ((op.T255_Flag_Status = '98' OR COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') NOT IN ('', '0')))) OR :status = CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status = '98' OR COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') NOT IN ('', '0')) THEN 'Cancelada' WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status = '99' THEN 'Finalizada' ELSE 'Aberta' END)

AND (:op = 0 OR op.T255_Id = :op) AND (:planoCorte = '' OR (:planoCorte = 'S' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT134 AS corte WHERE corte.SMT134_T255_Id = op.T255_Id)) OR (:planoCorte = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT134 AS corte WHERE corte.SMT134_T255_Id = op.T255_Id)))

AND ((:setor = '' AND :acabamento = '' AND :material = '' AND :produto = '') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id AND (:setor = '' OR prod.D001_D060_Id = :setor) AND (:acabamento = '' OR prod.D001_D015_Id = :acabamento) AND (:material = '' OR ext.D001A_SMT029_Id = :material) AND (:produto = '' OR prod.D001_Codigo_Produto LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%') OR prod.D001_Descricao_Produto LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%'))))

AND (:cliente = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T257A AS pesoCliente INNER JOIN T005 AS pv ON pv.T005_Id = pesoCliente.T257A_T005_Id AND pv.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id INNER JOIN D024 AS cl ON cl.D024_Id = pv.T005_D024_Id WHERE pesoCliente.T257A_T257_Id = realizado.T257_Id AND cl.D024_Nome_Empresa LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%')))
AND realizado.T257_Data_Producao >= :dataInicio
AND realizado.T257_Data_Producao <= :dataFim) AS realizado_maquina GROUP BY maquina ORDER BY maquina

programado.criterio: Peso previsto na data de início, sem repetir por produto ou pedido. Respeita empresa e filtros aplicados. O cadastro, a máquina e a situação são os atuais da OP. CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao, '%Y-%m'), ' / Semana ', FLOOR((DAYOFMONTH(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) - 1 + WEEKDAY(DATE_SUB(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao, INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) - 1 DAY))) / 7) + 1) AS semanaMes,

CASE WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pesoAberto,

CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE() THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pesoAtrasado,

CASE WHEN (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao >= :dataInicio AND p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao <= :dataFim) THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pesoPeriodo,

CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') AND op.T255_Data_Emissao <= :dataFim) AND (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao IS NULL OR CAST(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS CHAR) IN ('', '0000-00-00') OR p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NULL OR CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) IN ('', '0000-00-00')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS qtdSemDatas,

CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') AND op.T255_Data_Emissao <= :dataFim) AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS qtdSemPeso
FROM T255 AS op
LEFT JOIN T255A AS p ON p.T255A_Id = (SELECT MAX(px.T255A_Id) FROM T255A AS px WHERE px.T255A_T255_Id = op.T255_Id)
WHERE ((:abrangenciaEmpresa = 'atual' AND op.T255_C004_Id = :empresa) OR ((:abrangenciaEmpresa = 'todas' OR :abrangenciaEmpresa = CAST(op.T255_C004_Id AS CHAR)) AND op.T255_C004_Id IN (1, 2, 4, 5)))
AND (:maquina = '' OR CAST(p.T255A_Flag_Maquina AS CHAR) = :maquina)

AND ((:status = '' AND NOT ((op.T255_Flag_Status = '98' OR COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') NOT IN ('', '0')))) OR :status = CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status = '98' OR COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') NOT IN ('', '0')) THEN 'Cancelada' WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status = '99' THEN 'Finalizada' ELSE 'Aberta' END)

AND (:op = 0 OR op.T255_Id = :op) AND (:planoCorte = '' OR (:planoCorte = 'S' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT134 AS corte WHERE corte.SMT134_T255_Id = op.T255_Id)) OR (:planoCorte = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT134 AS corte WHERE corte.SMT134_T255_Id = op.T255_Id)))

AND ((:setor = '' AND :acabamento = '' AND :material = '' AND :produto = '') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id AND (:setor = '' OR prod.D001_D060_Id = :setor) AND (:acabamento = '' OR prod.D001_D015_Id = :acabamento) AND (:material = '' OR ext.D001A_SMT029_Id = :material) AND (:produto = '' OR prod.D001_Codigo_Produto LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%') OR prod.D001_Descricao_Produto LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%'))))

AND (:cliente = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T256 AS ci INNER JOIN T006 AS vi ON vi.T006_Id = ci.T256_T006_Id INNER JOIN T005 AS pv ON pv.T005_Id = vi.T006_T005_Id AND pv.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id INNER JOIN D024 AS cl ON cl.D024_Id = pv.T005_D024_Id WHERE ci.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id AND cl.D024_Nome_Empresa LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%')))

AND ((p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao >= :dataInicio AND p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao <= :dataFim) OR (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') AND op.T255_Data_Emissao <= :dataFim))) AS conferencia_op WHERE `pesoPeriodo` <> 0

(SELECT MIN(ent.T256_Data_Previsao_Entrega) FROM T256 AS ent WHERE ent.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id AND ent.T256_Data_Previsao_Entrega IS NOT NULL AND CAST(ent.T256_Data_Previsao_Entrega AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00') AND COALESCE(ent.T256_Quantidade, 0) > COALESCE(ent.T256_Quantidade_Produzida, 0)) AS entregaProxima,

CASE WHEN NOT (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) THEN 'Encerrada' WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE() THEN 'Fim previsto vencido' WHEN NOT (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) THEN 'Sem início previsto' WHEN NOT (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) THEN 'Sem fim previsto' WHEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Liberado_Producao, 'N') <> 'S' THEN 'Sem liberação' WHEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) <= 0 THEN 'Sem peso previsto' ELSE 'Programada e liberada' END AS prioridade,

CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND ((op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE()) THEN 1 WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (NOT (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00'))) THEN 2 WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (NOT (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00'))) THEN 3 WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (COALESCE(p.T255A_Liberado_Producao, 'N') <> 'S') THEN 4 WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) <= 0) THEN 5 ELSE 6 END AS ordemPrioridade,

CONCAT(CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND ((op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE()) THEN 'Fim previsto vencido | ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (NOT (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00'))) THEN 'Sem início previsto | ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (NOT (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00'))) THEN 'Sem fim previsto | ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (COALESCE(p.T255A_Liberado_Producao, 'N') <> 'S') THEN 'Sem liberação | ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) <= 0) THEN 'Sem peso previsto | ' ELSE '' END) AS pendencias,

CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE() THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao) ELSE 0 END AS diasAtraso,
CASE WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pesoAberto,
CASE WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status = '99' AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pesoFinalizado,

CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE() THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pesoAtrasado,
CASE WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS opsAbertas,
CASE WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status = '99' AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS opsFinalizadas,

CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS opsAtrasadas,
CASE WHEN (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao >= :dataInicio AND p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao <= :dataFim) THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pesoPeriodo,
CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') AND op.T255_Data_Emissao <= :dataFim) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS qtdFila,

CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') AND op.T255_Data_Emissao <= :dataFim) AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Liberado_Producao, 'N') <> 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS qtdSemLiberacao,

CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') AND op.T255_Data_Emissao <= :dataFim) AND (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao IS NULL OR CAST(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS CHAR) IN ('', '0000-00-00') OR p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NULL OR CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) IN ('', '0000-00-00')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS qtdSemDatas,

CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') AND op.T255_Data_Emissao <= :dataFim) AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS qtdSemPeso
FROM T255 AS op
LEFT JOIN T255A AS p ON p.T255A_Id = (SELECT MAX(px.T255A_Id) FROM T255A AS px WHERE px.T255A_T255_Id = op.T255_Id)
WHERE ((:abrangenciaEmpresa = 'atual' AND op.T255_C004_Id = :empresa) OR ((:abrangenciaEmpresa = 'todas' OR :abrangenciaEmpresa = CAST(op.T255_C004_Id AS CHAR)) AND op.T255_C004_Id IN (1, 2, 4, 5)))
AND (:maquina = '' OR CAST(p.T255A_Flag_Maquina AS CHAR) = :maquina)

AND ((:status = '' AND NOT ((op.T255_Flag_Status = '98' OR COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') NOT IN ('', '0')))) OR :status = CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status = '98' OR COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') NOT IN ('', '0')) THEN 'Cancelada' WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status = '99' THEN 'Finalizada' ELSE 'Aberta' END)

AND (:op = 0 OR op.T255_Id = :op) AND (:planoCorte = '' OR (:planoCorte = 'S' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT134 AS corte WHERE corte.SMT134_T255_Id = op.T255_Id)) OR (:planoCorte = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SMT134 AS corte WHERE corte.SMT134_T255_Id = op.T255_Id)))

AND ((:setor = '' AND :acabamento = '' AND :material = '' AND :produto = '') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id AND (:setor = '' OR prod.D001_D060_Id = :setor) AND (:acabamento = '' OR prod.D001_D015_Id = :acabamento) AND (:material = '' OR ext.D001A_SMT029_Id = :material) AND (:produto = '' OR prod.D001_Codigo_Produto LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%') OR prod.D001_Descricao_Produto LIKE CONCAT('%', :produto, '%'))))

AND (:cliente = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T256 AS ci INNER JOIN T006 AS vi ON vi.T006_Id = ci.T256_T006_Id INNER JOIN T005 AS pv ON pv.T005_Id = vi.T006_T005_Id AND pv.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id INNER JOIN D024 AS cl ON cl.D024_Id = pv.T005_D024_Id WHERE ci.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id AND cl.D024_Nome_Empresa LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%')))

AND ((p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao >= :dataInicio AND p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao <= :dataFim) OR (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') AND op.T255_Data_Emissao <= :dataFim))) AS conferencia_op WHERE `qtdFila` <> 0

vencidas.criterio: OPs abertas com fim anterior a hoje. Respeita empresa e filtros aplicados. O cadastro, a máquina e a situação são os atuais da OP. Canceladas ficam fora quando o filtro Status está vazio. Cada OP aparece uma vez; o peso não é repetido por produto ou pedido.
sqlBase: SELECT `op`, `maquina`, `sequencial`, `dataInicio`, `dataFim`, `situacao`, `liberada`, `valor`, `clientes`, `pedidos`, `dimensoes`, `pendencias`, `opsAtrasadas` FROM (SELECT op.T255_Id AS id,
CAST(op.T255_Id AS CHAR) AS op,
p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS data,
p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS dataInicio,
p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS dataFim,
op.T255_Data_Emissao AS emissao,
COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) AS valor,
CASE CAST(p.T255A_Flag_Maquina AS CHAR) WHEN '0' THEN 'Blank' WHEN '1' THEN 'Slitter' WHEN '2' THEN 'Combinado' ELSE 'Não informada' END AS maquina,
p.T255A_Sequencial AS sequencial,
CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status = '98' OR COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') NOT IN ('', '0')) THEN 'Cancelada' WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status = '99' THEN 'Finalizada' ELSE 'Aberta' END AS situacao,
COALESCE(p.T255A_Observacao, '') AS dimensoes,
COALESCE(op.T255_Observacao, '') AS observacao,
CASE WHEN p.T255A_Liberado_Producao = 'S' THEN 'Sim' ELSE 'Não' END AS liberada,

(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CAST(pedido.T005_Id AS CHAR) ORDER BY CAST(pedido.T005_Id AS CHAR) SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id LEFT JOIN D060 AS setor ON setor.D060_Id = prod.D001_D060_Id LEFT JOIN D015 AS acabamento ON acabamento.D015_Id = prod.D001_D015_Id LEFT JOIN SMT029 AS material ON material.SMT029_Id = ext.D001A_SMT029_Id LEFT JOIN T006 AS vendaItem ON vendaItem.T006_Id = item.T256_T006_Id LEFT JOIN T005 AS pedido ON pedido.T005_Id = vendaItem.T006_T005_Id AND pedido.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id LEFT JOIN D024 AS cliente ON cliente.D024_Id = pedido.T005_D024_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id) AS pedidos,

(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(cliente.D024_Nome_Empresa, 'Estoque / sem pedido') ORDER BY COALESCE(cliente.D024_Nome_Empresa, 'Estoque / sem pedido') SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id LEFT JOIN D060 AS setor ON setor.D060_Id = prod.D001_D060_Id LEFT JOIN D015 AS acabamento ON acabamento.D015_Id = prod.D001_D015_Id LEFT JOIN SMT029 AS material ON material.SMT029_Id = ext.D001A_SMT029_Id LEFT JOIN T006 AS vendaItem ON vendaItem.T006_Id = item.T256_T006_Id LEFT JOIN T005 AS pedido ON pedido.T005_Id = vendaItem.T006_T005_Id AND pedido.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id LEFT JOIN D024 AS cliente ON cliente.D024_Id = pedido.T005_D024_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id) AS clientes,

(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT prod.D001_Descricao_Produto ORDER BY prod.D001_Descricao_Produto SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM T256 AS item LEFT JOIN D009 AS estoque ON estoque.D009_Id = item.T256_D009_Id LEFT JOIN D001 AS prod ON prod.D001_Id = estoque.D009_D001_Id LEFT JOIN D001A AS ext ON ext.D001A_D001_Id = prod.D001_Id LEFT JOIN D060 AS setor ON setor.D060_Id = prod.D001_D060_Id LEFT JOIN D015 AS acabamento ON acabamento.D015_Id = prod.D001_D015_Id LEFT JOIN SMT029 AS material ON material.SMT029_Id = ext.D001A_SMT029_Id LEFT JOIN T006 AS vendaItem ON vendaItem.T006_Id = item.T256_T006_Id LEFT JOIN T005 AS pedido ON pedido.T005_Id = vendaItem.T006_T005_Id AND pedido.T005_C004_Id = op.T255_C004_Id LEFT JOIN D024 AS cliente ON cliente.D024_Id = pedido.T005_D024_Id WHERE item.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id) AS produtos,

CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao, '%Y-%m'), ' / Semana ', FLOOR((DAYOFMONTH(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) - 1 + WEEKDAY(DATE_SUB(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao, INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) - 1 DAY))) / 7) + 1) AS semanaMes,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 0 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS segunda,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 1 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS terca,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 2 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS quarta,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 3 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS quinta,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 4 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS sexta,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 5 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS sabado,
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao) = 6 THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS domingo,

(SELECT MIN(ent.T256_Data_Previsao_Entrega) FROM T256 AS ent WHERE ent.T256_T255_Id = op.T255_Id AND ent.T256_Data_Previsao_Entrega IS NOT NULL AND CAST(ent.T256_Data_Previsao_Entrega AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00') AND COALESCE(ent.T256_Quantidade, 0) > COALESCE(ent.T256_Quantidade_Produzida, 0)) AS entregaProxima,

CASE WHEN NOT (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) THEN 'Encerrada' WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE() THEN 'Fim previsto vencido' WHEN NOT (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) THEN 'Sem início previsto' WHEN NOT (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) THEN 'Sem fim previsto' WHEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Liberado_Producao, 'N') <> 'S' THEN 'Sem liberação' WHEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) <= 0 THEN 'Sem peso previsto' ELSE 'Programada e liberada' END AS prioridade,

CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND ((op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE()) THEN 1 WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (NOT (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00'))) THEN 2 WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (NOT (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00'))) THEN 3 WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (COALESCE(p.T255A_Liberado_Producao, 'N') <> 'S') THEN 4 WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) <= 0) THEN 5 ELSE 6 END AS ordemPrioridade,

CONCAT(CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND ((op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE()) THEN 'Fim previsto vencido | ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (NOT (p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Inicio_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00'))) THEN 'Sem início previsto | ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (NOT (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00'))) THEN 'Sem fim previsto | ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (COALESCE(p.T255A_Liberado_Producao, 'N') <> 'S') THEN 'Sem liberação | ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) <= 0) THEN 'Sem peso previsto | ' ELSE '' END) AS pendencias,

CASE WHEN (op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0')) AND (p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao IS NOT NULL AND CAST(p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao AS CHAR) NOT IN ('', '0000-00-00')) AND p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao < CURDATE() THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), p.T255A_Data_Fim_Producao) ELSE 0 END AS diasAtraso,
CASE WHEN op.T255_Flag_Status NOT IN ('98', '99') AND COALESCE(p.T255A_Flag_Cancelamento, '') IN ('', '0') THEN COALESCE(p.T255A_Peso_Previsto, 0) ELSE 0 END AS pesoAberto,
